prompt_instructions: Attach current authorized vehicle and logo references; do not fabricate engineering details.
Confirm all numerical performance claims against official current documentation before publishing.
Use a layout application for final small copy, diagrams, and technical labels.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Premium automotive collector poster for the Lamborghini Revuelto, futuristic magazine-style infographic layout, clean light stone or soft matte gray background, ultra-luxury exotic supercar advertisement aesthetic, combining photoreal car imagery, technical linework, aerospace-inspired graphic details, and premium modern typography. Cinematic lighting, ultra-crisp rendering, dramatic yet clean composition, 2:3 vertical format, collector-grade visual balance. Hero visual: A full three-quarter front view of a Lamborghini Revuelto in vivid Verde Scandal or metallic Arancio orange, featuring its sharp Y-shaped lighting signature, sculpted hybrid-era bodywork, large side intakes, angular hood surfaces, and aggressive stance. The car sits on a dark high-end studio track surface with subtle reflections. Background elements hint at a futuristic mountain road or private supercar test route. The design should radiate modern power, exotic engineering, and theatrical presence. Layout structure (top to bottom): 1. Header: Top-left Lamborghini bull emblem and "Lamborghini" wordmark. Large title: "REVUELTO" Subtitle: "V12 REBORN. ELECTRIFIED FURY." Top-right tagline: "The first HPEV V12 Lamborghini. A new beast begins." Include a short descriptive paragraph emphasizing the Revuelto as Lamborghini’s new flagship and the reinvention of the V12 era through hybrid performance. 2. Technical design layer: Use faint blueprint sketches of the Revuelto side profile, rear diffuser, and chassis layout in the background. Include subtle line-art diagrams of the hybrid system, battery tunnel layout, and V12 engine placement. Add small angular technical overlays inspired by aerospace interfaces. 3. Performance stats bar: Below the hero car, include a sleek horizontal stat section: - Powertrain: "6.5L Naturally Aspirated V12 + 3 Electric Motors" - Combined Output: "1,001 CV" - 0-100 km/h: "2.5 s" - Top Speed: "350+ KM/H" - Transmission: "8-Speed Dual-Clutch" - Architecture: "HPEV Carbon Fiber Monofuselage" 4. Secondary views: Two smaller visuals: - rear three-quarter angle with taillights and diffuser - cockpit or front detail close-up Between them, a dramatic central quote: "Not evolution. Detonation." 5. Heritage timeline: Bottom strip showing Lamborghini flagship V12 lineage: - Countach - Diablo - Murciélago - Aventador - Revuelto Each labeled with years and model names in a refined linear timeline. 6. Footer: Left-side quote: "A Lamborghini should look like speed even when standing still." Right-side text block: "DRAMA. INNOVATION. DOMINANCE." Add a compact technical note about the hybrid V12 philosophy. Color palette: Light stone gray background, vivid green or orange hero car, black typography, subtle neon-lime or bronze accents, carbon-fiber gray. Typography: Bold geometric sans-serif, sharp modern display type, clean premium body copy, with a high-tech luxury presentation. Style notes: The poster should feel aggressive, futuristic, elegant, and unmistakably Lamborghini. It should look like a premium launch poster mixed with a collector’s engineering infographic.
prompt.negative_prompt: wrong vehicle generation, incorrect badge, fabricated specs, warped wheels, unreadable technical copy, generic sports car, low resolution, watermark, signature
